$comment: Railway builds this repo from the Dockerfile. This is a batch/interactive tool, not a web server — see docs/RAILWAY.md for how to actually drive it (Railway shell / one-off commands) and why a persistent Volume + object storage matter (containers are ephemeral).

deploy.startCommand: bash -lc 'scripts/doctor.sh; echo; echo "Container ready. Open the Railway shell and run the pipeline (see docs/RAILWAY.md)."; tail -f /dev/null'
